explication: Mangayomi is a cross-platform Flutter reader for manga, novels, anime, and related media. The README establishes the user workflow and capabilities, but the supplied tree contains no Flutter/Dart application sources, so the UI, library, reader, tracking, categories, and backup implementation cannot be mapped directly. The graph therefore focuses on visible native runtime pieces: the documented content workflow, native Aidoku source engine and HTTP API, EPUB support, and platform bridges. Links to unsampled product stages are documented at a high level; unverified implementation connections are omitted.
